title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Generate Swiss QR Code without external services/APIs
summary: Business Central includes a standard Swiss QR Code Helper codeunit that allows developers to generate QR codes natively without external APIs. The post demonstrates how to add a page action that generates a Swiss QR code from item data and saves it to the item picture.
key_points: The Barcode module in System Application provides 2D barcode support including QR codes since BC 2021 wave 2
Codeunit 4113 'Swiss QR Code Helper' is the standard Microsoft method for generating Swiss QR codes
QR codes can be generated directly in AL code using the Swiss QR Code Helper without external services
Generated QR code images can be imported and stored as item pictures in the database

quotes.text: The barcode functionality lets you convert an alphanumeric value in a report dataset into a barcode on a generated report.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the core barcode capability available in Business Central for standard use cases

quotes.text: If you just want to generate a Swiss QR Code, Microsoft has prepared a standard method for us.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights that Swiss QR code generation is a supported feature without needing external services
